readerCopy.body: A message becomes more powerful because nobody can agree on exactly what it promises. Mercury conjunct Neptune can make a speech, post, artistic statement, or private assurance feel meaningful while leaving enough room for each listener to hear the future they want. That ambiguity can build a large audience and a larger disappointment. The problem is not imagination; it is letting imagination stand in for terms. Put the promise into plain language and name what is not guaranteed before people begin planning around different versions of the same message.
